cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Credit for the Impossible
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you understood, predicted, or accepted the impossible truth before anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I gave the cupboard a pat like you. Well done, both of us. Tell it I believed in it before it could speak.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was shutting its door. It's asking for silence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Door settled, yes. One quick acknowledgment from you, then I'll be quiet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says you talk too much.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell it those were years of encouragement, before anyone else would listen to it.
